name: Coolant Heads Prevail
summary: Lotwil Veriatus wants a vial of Frost Oil to strengthen the shackles meant to hold a summoned friend in check. Bro'kin, a goblin friend of Lotwil's in Alterac, can teach you to make it.

sections.title: A Vital Coolant
sections.body: Lotwil Veriatus swears nothing keeps an engine or gears from overheating like Frost Oil, and that its worth as a lubricant is without equal. It also helps magical items hold on to their enchantments. A vial would raise the magical capacity of Lotwil's shackles, making them strong enough to stop the summoned friend from killing everyone.

sections.title: Bro'kin of Alterac
sections.body: Bro'kin, a goblin friend of Lotwil's, can teach you to make the oil. Bro'kin is in the Ruins of Alterac, and sells from a spot up on the wall of the old city.

sections.title: When the Oil Arrives
sections.body: Once the oil arrives, Lotwil calls it the perfect coolant for the new bracers. Lotwil swears that if the enchantments do not last a century, all Lotwil's belongings will go to Servo. Lotwil also expects the mages of the Assembly to be in awe when the work is finished.

faq.q: Why does Lotwil Veriatus need Frost Oil?
faq.answer: A vial would increase the magical capacity of Lotwil's shackles, so they are strong enough to stop the summoned friend from killing everyone.

faq.q: Who knows how to brew Frost Oil?
faq.answer: Bro'kin, a goblin friend of Lotwil's, can teach you to make it. He is in the Ruins of Alterac, up on a wall of the old city.

faq.q: What is special about Frost Oil?
faq.answer: Lotwil says nothing keeps an engine or gears from overheating like it, that it lasts as a lubricant without equal, and that it helps magical items hold on to enchantments.
